title: Nondeterministic space complexity class
statement: For a function $s:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, the class $\mathrm{NSPACE}(s)$ consists of the languages of Boolean strings for which there exist a natural number $c$ and a finite nondeterministic Turing machine that decides the language within space $n\mapsto c\,s(n)$.
